brief:
Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov described the situation in Gaza as a "stain of shame" on the international community, Shehab Wire reported. He criticized the failure to implement a UN Security Council resolution related to an American plan, despite Israeli airstrikes continuing and the humanitarian crisis worsening.

Lavrov's remarks came as a ceasefire remained nominally in effect in the territory, though the Russian diplomat suggested the accord had failed to halt fighting or address the broader humanitarian emergency unfolding there.

title: Lavrov calls Gaza crisis international disgrace over failed ceasefire
